categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: Intelligent Electrical Equipment, New Energy, and Intelligent Manufacturing. It focuses on digital energy and digital industrial sectors, providing smart grid terminal equipment, energy storage solutions, intelligent robots, mechanical arms, and related lifecycle services. The Intelligent Electrical segment includes smart distribution and low-voltage electrical devices; the New Energy segment covers integrated photovoltaic, energy storage, and charging solutions; Intelligent Manufacturing offers customized intelligent equipment and robotic solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in smart grids, new energy storage, industrial robotics, and intelligent manufacturing. It emphasizes R&D in new power systems, energy storage modules (including air-cooled and liquid-cooled storage cabinets), integrated photovoltaic and charging solutions, and robotic automation including mechanical arms and inspection robots. Production methods include customized non-standard intelligent equipment manufacturing, system integration, and software-hardware co-development with a focus on innovation and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include state-owned power grid companies (State Grid, Southern Grid), various power enterprises, new energy users, industrial and commercial clients, automotive manufacturers, and engineering machinery sectors. The company serves domestic markets primarily in China, focusing on energy, industrial automation, and new energy sectors, with growing global market expansion in energy storage and smart grid solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with core markets in East China (Shanghai, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Fujian, Shandong), Central China, North China, South China, Southwest, Northeast, Northwest, and some overseas presence. It has subsidiaries and operations in Shanghai, Hefei, Suzhou, Shenzhen, and Germany, among others, supporting both domestic and international business activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing core intelligent electrical equipment, energy storage systems, and intelligent manufacturing equipment. It acts as a system integrator and solution provider, supplying products and services directly to end customers and industrial users, while maintaining strategic partnerships with upstream suppliers for components and materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on digital energy and digital industrial transformation, emphasizing new power systems, energy storage, smart grids, and intelligent manufacturing. The company prioritizes R&D investment in core technologies such as integrated smart distribution devices, energy storage modules, robotic automation, and AI-driven control systems. It aims to enhance product innovation, cost control, and market adaptability to support China's carbon neutrality goals and energy revolution.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of products including intelligent electrical equipment, energy storage solutions, and intelligent manufacturing systems. The company secures orders primarily via bidding and direct contracts, providing customized solutions and after-sales services. Revenue streams also include technology development services, equipment installation, and maintenance contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a competitive position in the Chinese power and industrial automation sectors, with recognized market share in intelligent electrical equipment and energy storage. It faces intense competition in the intelligent manufacturing segment, which is currently loss-making due to market saturation and fierce competition. The company leverages its technological innovation, quality certifications, and strategic partnerships to maintain industry influence and expand in new energy markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.1 billion, a slight decline compared to the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 128 million, though the loss narrowed significantly from prior years. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D (about 8.37% of revenue) and is in a scale investment phase for energy storage. It has total assets of around RMB 5.44 billion and net assets of RMB 1.65 billion, reflecting a medium-sized enterprise with a focus on growth in digital energy sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and integrated solutions tailored to customer needs in smart grids, energy storage, and intelligent manufacturing. It differentiates through high-quality products, comprehensive lifecycle services, and strategic collaborations with leading research institutions. Its focus on innovation, customization, and alignment with national energy and carbon goals positions it as a key player in advancing digital energy and industrial automation.
